title: bothriochloa bladhii subsp. glabra

It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Bothriochloa bladhii subsp. glabra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
